title: A real affine (23_4) configuration
description: An explicit rational, Lean-verified real (23_4) configuration; a second configuration over Q(sqrt(17)); and exact evidence that these are the two projective classes admitting a Klein four-group of collineations. Includes the complete V4 candidate audit, independently replayed exclusions, solved survivor loci, and the CT1-S1 comparison. Publication priority is not asserted. The sharing cover is generated promotional artwork; the exact figures and coordinates are the mathematical reference.
